record.field: SELECT a.tplnr, d.pltxt, a.tplma, c.werks, if.abckz, b.eqfnr FROM iflot a JOIN iflotx d ON a.mandt=d.mandt AND a.tplnr=d.tplnr AND d.spras='E' JOIN (SELECT tplnr, MAX(eqfnr) AS eqfnr, MAX(swerk) AS swerk, mandt FROM iloa GROUP BY tplnr, mandt) b ON a.mandt=b.mandt AND a.tplnr=b.tplnr JOIN t001w c ON b.mandt=c.mandt AND b.swerk=c.werks left join iflo if on a.tplnr = if.tplnr and a.mandt = if.mandt where c.werks in ('1443', '1321')
select a.CODE, a.KURZTEXT from QPCT a where a.KATALOGART = 'C' AND a.CODEGRUPPE = 'PM1'
